items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: John Fatus (phonetic sp.) was there. Jack Mooyel (phonetic sp.) and John Motley.

ctx.x: about what it is that's going to be put out in public under his name.

And you know what? That's like when Dizzy passed away. When Dizzy passed away at the hospital, I was there with him. John Fatus (phonetic sp.) was there. Jack Mooyel (phonetic sp.) and John Motley. And then when we read about it and heard about it over the news, they said he passed away with music playing. Dizzy's diamond was playing, and it's a damn lie. Dizzy was sitting in a chair trying to breathe. And he died sitting up. You know. And I'm looking right at him. And there were four of us in the room. And…
